name: last30days-skill
description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
one_liner: Gives an AI assistant the job of a research intern: it scours Reddit, Twitter/X, YouTube, Hacker News, prediction markets, and the web on any topic, then writes you one clear summary of what people are actually saying.
buyer: A startup founder or market researcher validating a new product idea who doesn't have time to manually read dozens of forums and threads.
business_use_cases: A startup founder runs it before a feature launch to see what real users on Reddit and X are already saying about the problem they're solving.
A hedge fund analyst uses it to get a quick pulse-check on what prediction markets and social chatter say about an upcoming event.
A marketing agency generates 'what's being said about [brand]' briefs for clients without paying for an enterprise social-listening tool.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'market pulse' report-as-a-service: client picks a topic, gets a polished weekly research digest delivered by email

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple web form with a Stripe paywall: enter a topic, get a research digest emailed in 10 minutes, charge per report or a monthly plan for unlimited topics.
